context: A uni student catches up with a teen friend after exams
purpose: Teach: いまや/おくれ/暖かく/例年/短時間/知り合っ/昼寝/甘え

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: さくら、ひさしぶり！試験やっと終わったよ。例年より日程がずれて大変だった。
lines.en: Sakura, long time no see! Exams are finally over. The schedule shifted from the usual years and it was rough.
lines.style: Warm, relieved university student greeting a younger friend casually.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: おつかれ！連絡おくれてごめんね。最近やっと暖かくなってきたから外で会いたかったんだ。
lines.en: Good work! Sorry my reply was late. It's finally gotten warm, so I wanted to meet outside.
lines.style: Cheerful teen tone, slightly apologetic but excited to reconnect.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いまや大学生って感じで忙しくてさ、短時間しか空かないけど話せて嬉しいよ。
lines.en: I'm full-on uni life now and crazy busy — I only have a short window, but I'm glad we can talk.
lines.style: Mature but friendly, hinting at adult schedule constraints.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: そういえば、私たちが知り合ったのって中学の時だよね。もう何年も経つなんて信じられない。
lines.en: Come to think of it, we first met back in middle school, right? I can't believe it's been years.
lines.style: Nostalgic teen reflection, voice softening with memory.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ほんとだね。あの頃の俺、放課後すぐ昼寝してたの覚えてる？
lines.en: Yeah, really. Do you remember how I'd take a nap right after school back then?
lines.style: Playful, teasing himself with a fond laugh.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 覚えてるよ！お母さんに甘えてばっかりで、起こしてもらってたよね。
lines.en: I remember! You were always being spoiled by your mom and having her wake you up.
lines.style: Teasing, giggly teen calling out an embarrassing memory.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: やめてよ恥ずかしい…。さくらは部活どう？相変わらず頑張ってる？
lines.en: Stop, that's embarrassing... How's your club going? Still working hard as ever?
lines.style: Mock-flustered, deflecting with a genuine question.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、大会近いから毎日へとへと。今度ゆっくりご飯行こうよ！
lines.en: Yeah, the tournament is close so I'm exhausted every day. Let's go grab a proper meal next time!
lines.style: Energetic but tired teen, ending the chat warmly with an invitation.
